# GasBuddy

> GasBuddy is a gas price comparison and fuel savings platform that helps drivers find the cheapest gas stations and earn rewards.

GasBuddy operates across North America and provides real-time gas price information through a mobile app and web platform. The service combines gas price discovery with a rewards program (Pay with GasBuddy+) that offers cashback and fuel discounts.

## Key Topics

- Gas price finder
- Cheapest gas stations
- Pay with GasBuddy+
- GasBack rewards
- Fuel savings
- Mobile app
- Gas discount card
- Cashback
- E85 fuel
- Navigation
- Rewards program
- North America coverage

## Core Platform

- [GasBuddy - Cheapest Gas Station Finder App with Money Saving Benefits](https://www.gasbuddy.com): GasBuddy homepage: find cheapest gas stations and save with Pay with GasBuddy+ rewards.
